title: VALDORIA
subtitle: Campaign Map
blurb: From Mill Road to Castle Morvane: 34 stops, 6 choice points, 22 stops per run.

backgroundWide._not: Geniş (21:9) harita görseli (Ömer onayı 2026-10-22): kaynak assets/source/maps-1/valdoria-map-v2-wide.png (2193x940; ortası piksel piksel valdoria-map-v2.png, x=260..1931) -> assets/campaign/valdoria-bg-wide.webp (2195x941, valdoria-bg ile aynı dikey ölçek, WebP q86). region = 16:9 haritanın (valdoria-bg, 1672x941) bu görselde kapladığı dikdörtgen [x0, y0, x1, y1] (kesir): x = 261..1933 px, tam yükseklik (piksel karşılaştırmasıyla ölçüldü). Düğüm konumları (pos) değişmez (src/game/wide-map.ts).

backgroundExt._not: Kenar taşmalı harita görseli (Harita 2 playtest 2026-10-25, Ömer seçeneği (a); tools/make-map-ext.mjs ile üretilir): asıl görsel dört kenardan aynalanıp kademeli bulanıklaştırılmış, kenara doğru koyulaşan vinyetli taşma alanıyla genişletildi. regions.title: I · The Borderlands
regions.tagline: From Mill Road over the moors to the Iron Pass

regions.title: II · Valdren Vale
regions.tagline: From Valdren Keep through marsh and graves to the bridge

regions.title: III · The Northern Heights
regions.tagline: From the Ashen Plain to Morvane's gate

nodes.name: Mill Road
nodes.subtitle: Start · Battle
nodes.lore: The old mill road hugs the western coast, and lately its travellers pay the thugs in coin or blood.

nodes.name: Ravenwood
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Outlaw Pack
nodes.lore: Wolves and poachers rule the shadowed Ravenwood, where ravens watch every traveller who strays from the path.

nodes.name: Ruined Watchtower
nodes.subtitle: Elite · Bandit Chief
nodes.lore: A crumbling watchtower once guarded the borderlands; now a bandit chief counts his plunder among its broken stones.

nodes.name: Ashford Village
nodes.subtitle: Town · Inn, Recruits, Trade
nodes.lore: A quiet village of thatch and smoke, the last safe hearth before the road turns north toward the ash.

hotspots.label: Notice Board
hotspots.note: Notices of burned farms and missing travellers. No one here seeks to join a company. Recruits gather in the cities.

nodes.name: Windy Moor
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Moor Raiders
nodes.lore: Wind howls across the open heath, and raiders ride it down on anyone foolish enough to cross alone.
nodes.label: above

nodes.name: Brackenridge
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Hill Bandits
nodes.lore: Bracken hides the old hill track to Cairn Hill, and the thugs who fled Mill Road wait in it for stragglers.

nodes.name: Raiders' Hoard
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: The moor raiders bury their plunder on the western cape and post guards over the cairn that hides it.

nodes.name: Cairn Hill
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Cairn Raiders
nodes.lore: Old cairns crown this windswept hill, and raiders and ember-priests gather among the stones to watch the roads below.

nodes.name: Hillside Camp
nodes.subtitle: Rest · Camp
nodes.lore: A sheltered fold below Cairn Hill where road-weary companies light their fires before the climb north.

nodes.name: Iron Pass
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Ambush
nodes.lore: A narrow dwarven pass carved through the hills, its old stone guardians still standing watch in the cold.

nodes.name: Charcoal Camp
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Charcoal Burners
nodes.lore: Smoke never clears over the charcoal camp, where the burners now feed their fires to the Ash Lord's glory.

nodes.name: Valdren Keep
nodes.subtitle: City · Inn, Smith, Recruits, Trade
nodes.lore: Valdren Keep still flies the king's banner, though its soldiers stopped waiting for his return long ago.
nodes.label: above

hotspots.label: Barracks
hotspots.note: The barracks are quiet. Every sword here has already sworn to someone.

nodes.name: Dwarven Mine
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: The dwarves left their mine long ago, but its wardens never stopped guarding what lies in the dark.
nodes.label: above

nodes.name: Witch's Hut
nodes.subtitle: Event · Guarded
nodes.lore: Deep in the reeds a crooked hut steams with strange brews, and the hedge witch always names a price.

nodes.name: Misty Marsh
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Bog Ambush
nodes.lore: Fog lies thick over the marsh, and the drowned rise from the black water to drag the living down.
nodes.label: above

nodes.name: Sunken Shrine
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: A drowned shrine rises from the reeds at low water, and the dead who tended it still keep their vigil.

nodes.name: Grave Field
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Restless Dead
nodes.lore: The dead of old wars lie restless here, stirred from their graves by the curse creeping south.
nodes.label: above

nodes.name: Pilgrim Road
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Rival Company
nodes.lore: Pilgrims once walked this road to St. Brann's in peace; now sellswords hunt it for the abbey's relics.

nodes.name: St. Brann's Abbey
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Relic Vault
nodes.lore: Sworn brothers keep St. Brann's relic vault, sealed and untouched for a hundred years.
nodes.label: above

nodes.name: Black Cathedral
nodes.subtitle: Elite · The Undying
nodes.lore: Beneath the black spires a choir sings to the dead, and the dead answer, refusing to stay buried.

nodes.name: Riverside Camp
nodes.subtitle: Rest · Camp
nodes.lore: A sheltered bend in the river where weary companies light their fires and tend to their fallen.
nodes.label: above

nodes.name: King's Bridge
nodes.subtitle: Boss · The Bridge Warden
nodes.lore: A warden swore to hold the bridge until the king returned; the king never came, and the warden never left.

nodes.name: Ashen Plain
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Cursed Ground
nodes.lore: Grey ash falls like snow over dead fields, and hounds and bone-singers roam where farms once stood.

nodes.name: Supply Wagons
nodes.subtitle: Treasure · Guarded
nodes.lore: Morvane's supply wagons wait at the edge of the forest, heavy with arms for the siege.

nodes.name: Siege Line
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Morvane's Vanguard
nodes.lore: Morvane's halberdiers hold the trenches here in close ranks, the first wall of his marching vanguard.

nodes.name: Thornwood Hollow
nodes.subtitle: Elite · Hidden Lair
nodes.lore: Hidden among the thorns, a drake cult gathers in a hollow that reeks of smoke and brimstone.

nodes.name: Forward Camp
nodes.subtitle: Merchant · Last Supplies
nodes.lore: The last camp below the heights, where Odo sells what supplies remain to those still marching north.

nodes.name: Ember Road
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Outriders
nodes.lore: Embers drift along the road to the castle, and Morvane's outriders patrol it with hounds at their heels.

nodes.name: Shepherd's Fold
nodes.subtitle: Event · Rest
nodes.lore: Shepherds huddle in a stone fold beneath the heights, their flocks scattered by beasts from the road.
nodes.label: above

nodes.name: Burnt Hamlet
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Ash Ghouls
nodes.lore: Nothing is left of the hamlet but ash and chimneys, and the dead buried here no longer rest.

nodes.name: Riverhead
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Spring Ambush
nodes.lore: The river springs from the rocks here, its cold waters fouled by the drowned dead of the north.

nodes.name: Gate of Cinders
nodes.subtitle: Battle · Gatewardens
nodes.lore: Knights in cinder-cracked plate guard the last road to the castle, shields locked before a gate that never sleeps.

nodes.name: Deserters' Camp
nodes.subtitle: Elite · Deserter Captain
nodes.lore: Soldiers who fled Morvane's gate hide in the snow above it, led by a captain who answers to no lord.

nodes.name: Castle Morvane
nodes.subtitle: Final Boss
nodes.lore: From this black castle the Ash Curse spreads across Valdoria, and Lord Morvane waits beneath his crown of ash.
